title: Things

post.title: Why the New Thing Stops Making You Happy #shorts
post.description: Trip or thing? Tell me in the comments. Send this to the friend whose cart is always full. Dev buys a smart watch: 'This'll make me happy for years.' By week three it's just a watch. In 'To Do or to Have? That Is the Question' (Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 2003), Leaf Van Boven and Thomas Gilovich reported a national survey of more than 12,000 Americans: asked about purchases made to increase their happiness, most said the experience made them happier than the material thing. Their lab studies agreed. Experiences turn into stories: we reinterpret them kindly, share them, and make them part of who we are. Buy the memory. #psychology #shorts #happiness #experiences #overthinking
